title: Furniture and decor
author: claude
summary: The rug, credenza, art, chandelier, plants, floor lamp and curtains.
what: We added the rug, the credenza, the art, the chandelier, the plants and fig, the floor lamp and the curtains.
why: These are the things that make the room look lived in and match the reference images.
how:
- The credenza follows the reference: smoked walnut, a door, two stacked drawers and another door, a marble top with lips, black sled legs, and decor.
- The rug is 5 m by 3.5 m.

tech.name: Blender
tech.plain: Free 3D software. We use it to build the room and to calculate how light falls in it.

tech.name: Python scripts
tech.plain: Small programs that tell Blender what to build and bake, so every step can be repeated.
